A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same IBG research work. Their complete main texts and Appendices A–P, including equations, figures and tables, support reliable comparison despite substantial reformatting.

before.justification: Sections 6 and Appendix M report original IBG-NN/IbgE results for node classification, traffic forecasting, knowledge-graph completion, efficiency and ablations.

after.justification: Sections 6 and Appendix M retain original empirical results and add large-graph evaluations, sparse-graph timing, initialization experiments and sensitivity analyses.

M1.justification: The IBG factorization, weighted Frobenius objective, neural architecture, SVD/Monte Carlo initialization, node/diode sampling algorithms and IbgE construction are retained. DeepSets was already documented in v2; the new controls and initialization experiments do not establish a revised proposed method.

E1.justification: v3 adds Products and the Ogbn-Arxiv classification task to the large-graph evaluation, plus homophilic Citeseer-full and Cora-ML graphs in the topology analysis. Arxiv-Year was already evaluated in v2. Runtime coverage expands from dense ER(n, 0.5) graphs to sparse ER(n, 25/n) graphs.

E2.justification: v3 adds SimGC to both large-graph comparison tables, removes DC-Graph from both, and removes Coarsening from the main comparison while retaining it in Table 5. The directed classification table drops LINKX, ACM-GCN and Gradient Gating and adds an undirected IBG control. The FaberNet runtime comparison is removed, although its classification results remain. Appendix J additionally reports an ICG-NN-with-DeepSets comparison.

E3.justification: The stated Flickr/Reddit approximation budget changes from 0 epochs in v2 Table 12 to 1000 in v3 Table 16; this establishes a reported setting revision, not that experiments were rerun. Added protocols include Arxiv/Products sampling ratios, joint community-count/densification sweeps, and convergence timing using a 0.5% improvement threshold over 500 epochs.

E4.justification: v3 adds controls separating directionality and densification, a large-graph densification ablation, SVD-versus-random initialization timing and quality comparisons, joint hyperparameter sensitivity, optimization trajectories and topology analysis. Conversely, v2's Squirrel edge-thinning robustness experiment is removed. Existing community-count, densification-strength and memory analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report means and standard deviations over five seeds for large-graph and traffic experiments and ten splits for directed classification. Added analyses largely follow these existing practices. No increased run count for retained experiments or new confidence-interval/significance-testing procedure is reported.

E6.justification: v3 adds numerous benchmark and diagnostic results. Table 2 reports Arxiv 64.4±1.1 and Products 61.9±0.3, below SFGC 65.5±0.7 and SimGC 63.3±1.1 respectively. Full-sampling Reddit IBG results change from 93.6±0.5 to 94.1±0.5, alongside changed reported training budgets, so a same-setting gain is not established. Full-graph comparator scores are replaced. The headline directed-classification, traffic and knowledge-completion IBG results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Theorem 4.1 and the substantive definitions, bounds, derivations and proofs in Appendices B–I are retained. Added explanations and restated ICG/IBG formulas do not change the mathematical results or formal assumptions.

C1.justification: Both versions claim approximation ranks independent of graph size and sparsity under densifying similarity, node-linear IBG-NN processing, and strong performance across the same broad application domains. v3 expands the supporting evidence without redefining these central contributions.

C2.justification: v3 adds interpretations separating directionality from densification, explaining Tolokers' limited improvement, recommending hyperparameters, and discussing initialization efficiency and topology-dependent behavior. Appendices J and N expand applicability discussion. However, v2's explicit limitations concerning small local structures and transferring fitted IBGs between graphs are removed rather than relocated.

D1.justification: Appendix P specifies selected depths, dimensions and learning rates where v2 often listed alternatives, explains which condensation ratios use 50 versus 750 communities, and supplies Ogbn-Arxiv/Products hyperparameters. These improve documentation without establishing changes to every retained experiment. The stated GPU, Adam optimizer and code-access URL are unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds references including Hu et al., Xiao et al., Oskarsson et al., Smit et al. and Bechler-Speicher et al., while removing several references associated with deleted comparisons. It expands motivation from directed-graph applications, but retains the fundamental positioning as a densifying, directed extension of ICG.

P1.justification: v3 substantially revises the introduction and experimental narrative, organizes Section 6 around Q1–Q3, promotes directed classification from Appendix M to Section 6.2, and folds Section 4.6 into 4.5. It adds appendix contents and reproducibility/ethics statements while reorganizing supplementary experiments.

P2.justification: v3 adopts the ICLR template and extensively rearranges displays. The directed-classification table moves into the main text, the large-graph table expands, and the retained dense-runtime plot gains a sparse-runtime panel. New ablation tables, heatmaps and convergence plots accompany removal of the duplicate Squirrel display, edge-thinning plot and FaberNet runtime panel.

improvement.justification: Compared with v2, the component controls and initialization experiments better substantiate the mechanisms and practical efficiency, while broader large-graph evaluation and more precise hyperparameters strengthen empirical support and reproducibility. These gains are tempered by removal of explicit local-structure and transfer limitations, and continued state-of-the-art language despite Table 2 showing stronger competitors on the added Arxiv and Products benchmarks.
